name: Flight Delay Auto-Payout
basedOn: AI Insurance Chatbot Platform (Team Rep Monkeys)
idea: Reasons through a travel policy and pays delay claims as soon as airport data shows a qualifying delay.
twist: Handles rebooked flights and Don Mueang-to-Suvarnabhumi switches by recalculating eligibility before paying.
sources: The Hammurabi (Stanford LLM x Law Hackathon Fall 2024, Best VC, Stanford) — AI platform that reasons through insurance contract logic to determine outcomes for specific scenarios, asking clarifying questions before concluding.

AI Insurance Chatbot Platform (Team Rep Monkeys) (SingHacks 2025 (Ancileo x MSIG Conversational Insurance Challenge), Singapore, 3rd) — Agentic conversational travel-insurance system that extracts trip details from documents, supports voice purchase and recommends plans by destination and activity.

name: Reusable Box Loop
idea: Schedules rider pickups of reusable ShopeeFood containers, batching returns into existing delivery routes.
twist: Re-plans pickups when riders are scarce in rain, and rewards users with coins tied to Shopee games.
sources: GoZero (Alibaba Cloud Indonesia GenAI Hackathon 2025 (with GoTo), Indonesia, 3rd) — Gamified tool that helps delivery users reduce packaging waste and guides recycling.

name: ยาครบ Pill Routine
idea: Checks photos of an elder's pill organiser against the prescription and alerts family about missed or wrong doses.
twist: Updates the plan automatically when a new hospital prescription slip is photographed, flagging drug changes for the pharmacist.
sources: PillSnap (SGHackItRX 2025 (Pharmaceutical Society of Singapore), 1st Runner-up) — AI tool that detects and identifies multiple pills from one photo to help pharmacists with medication reconciliation.

PostVisit.ai (Anthropic Built with Opus 4.6 Claude Code Hackathon 2026 (virtual), 3rd place) — Explains medical diagnoses in plain language, analyzes visit notes and surfaces clinical evidence for patients between appointments.

name: ยายสั่งได้ Voice Shopper
idea: Lets an elder order groceries on Shopee by voice in Thai dialect, completing checkout within a family-set budget.
twist: Picks safe substitutes when items run out and calls the family before anything over budget or unfamiliar ships.
sources: Welli (OutSystems AI Agent Hackathon 2025 (Japan & Korea), Enterprise 1st) — Voice-based AI life-support app for seniors who face digital access barriers.

Vite Vere Offline (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), 2nd place) — Offline digital companion that turns images into simple read-aloud instructions to foster autonomy for people with cognitive disabilities.

name: Footpath Navigator
idea: Guides blind pedestrians along Bangkok footpaths with a chest phone camera and voice instructions.
twist: Re-routes around street vendors, parked motorbikes and night markets that appear and vanish by time of day.
sources: Hanamo (OutSystems AI Agent Hackathon 2025 (Japan & Korea), MVP Award) — Mobility safety support app for people with visual impairments.

Gemma Vision (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), 1st place) — AI assistant for visually impaired people that processes chest-mounted phone camera visuals and responds to voice or controller commands.

name: Deaf Rider Relay
idea: Handles customer calls for deaf delivery riders, converting speech to text and sign and replying on their behalf.
twist: Answers routine questions autonomously and switches to sign video for tricky ones, like a gated condo entry.
sources: Signity (Microsoft ASEAN AI for Accessibility Hackathon 2025, Champion (UTP regional), Malaysia) — AI sign language translation app that integrates into platforms like TikTok and Shopee for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
Silentalk (Inter-University GenAI Hackathon for the SDGs 2025, Silver, Hong Kong) — AI sign language interpreter.

name: Sorting Lift Coach
idea: Camera scores worker lifting posture at parcel sorting centres and rotates workers between stations when risk accumulates.
twist: Changes rotation rules when peak volume hits during mega sales, so speed never overrides injury limits.
sources: Lifting Risk Analysis (Super AI Engineer: 5th National AI Exhibition 2025, Thailand, Best AI Innovation Award) — AI system that analyses the injury risk of improper postures when workers lift items.

name: Adaptive Rider Academy
basedOn: Team Road Runners police training simulator
idea: Generates riding scenarios targeted at each rider's weak habits from mock telematics and tracks improvement.
twist: Scenarios include Bangkok flash floods and motorbike U-turns, updating the curriculum after each real near-miss.
sources: Team Road Runners police training simulator (HacX! Hack for Public Safety 2025 (HTX x Microsoft), Singapore, Horizon 1st + Overall Impact) — Driving and riding training simulator for Singapore Police with an AI scenario engine, weather simulation and physiological/behavioural feedback.

name: Condo Night Guard
idea: Watches condo CCTV, separating real threats from cats, riders and residents, and alerts the guard only when needed.
twist: Adapts thresholds when lights fail or rain hits and logs delivery riders separately to cut false alarms.
sources: Sixth Sense for Security Guards (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), 4th place) — Video monitoring system that uses Gemma 3n to distinguish genuine threats from benign events in real-time security footage.
Hawkwatch (TreeHacks 2025, Stanford, Grand Prize) — Intelligent video-surveillance system that monitors multiple streams and sends real-time alerts when crime or life-threatening events are detected.

name: Work Permit Watchdog
idea: Tracks migrant workers' visa and work-permit expiry, prepares renewal documents and notifies employers in advance.
twist: Re-checks every case when cabinet resolutions change rules for Myanmar, Lao and Cambodian workers, in their own languages.
sources: MigrAssist (Inter-University GenAI Hackathon for the SDGs 2025, Gold, Hong Kong) — Chatbot that helps migrant workers in Hong Kong understand their rights, track legal changes and connect with NGOs.
HireCompass (Start Smart Hackathon Autumn 2025, shared 1st place, Estonia) — AI career tool that helps migrants and international students produce localized job applications and find employment.

name: TCAS Answer Desk
idea: Answers students' LINE and Facebook questions about university admission from official announcements and FAQs.
twist: Detects when a TCAS round date or rule changes, re-indexes and marks stale answers instead of repeating them.
sources: RaoChatHub (Super AI Engineer Season 5 (AI Innovator Track) 2025, Thailand, 1st (Eastern center)) — Chatbot platform that answers from real databases and uploaded documents, reads images with vision AI, and unifies Facebook, Instagram and LINE messages; deployed for 24/7 student Q&A at Burapha University.

name: Border School Tutor
idea: Runs an offline tutor on cheap hardware in border schools, syncing progress whenever internet returns.
twist: Switches between Thai and Karen explanations per student and adapts lessons when connectivity drops for days.
sources: LENTERA (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), Ollama Prize) — Offline educational microserver on affordable hardware for remote and disconnected rural regions.

Nexora-AI (Agent Development Kit Hackathon with Google Cloud 2025 (online), EMEA winner) — Personalized education platform that teaches through interactive lessons with visuals, quizzes and AI support.

name: Mock Exam Re-Planner
idea: Builds a study plan and mock exams for Thai university entrance tests and re-plans after every result.
twist: Detects reading-difficulty signs in handwritten answers and adapts plans for students who may have dyslexia.
sources: Edu.AI (Agent Development Kit Hackathon with Google Cloud 2025 (online), Latin America winner) — Multi-agent educational system for Brazil that evaluates essays, generates personalized study plans and creates interdisciplinary mock exams.

Dyscover (Wharton Hack-AI-thon 2025, 1st place AI for Education, Philadelphia) — Analyses handwriting samples to detect signs of dyslexia and generates tailored lesson plans for teachers via a GPT-4 chatbot.

name: Diamond Budget Guard
idea: A parent-set agent manages a child's Garena diamond top-up budget and explains spending as a story.
twist: Adjusts to limited-time skin events and suspicious top-up links, pausing purchases and teaching why.
sources: KancaKids (BI x OJK Hackathon 2025, Indonesia, Student 2nd) — AI-powered gamified, story-based financial literacy platform for children and teens with dashboards for parents and educators.

name: RoV Boost Ring Finder
idea: Analyses login and match graphs to find account-boosting and account-trading rings in mobile esports.
twist: Adapts when rings rotate devices or VPNs, linking them to Facebook groups selling ranked accounts.
sources: Mule Observation Detection Engine (KrungsriUniVerse x KMITL Hackathon: Mule Hunt Challenge 2025, Thailand, 1st) — Detects mule bank accounts by analysing links between gambling and loan networks tied to account trading plus social data, to block risk networks at the source.
